primary_locator.selected_parameter_scope: r=1 only; other r branches retained as unselected original context

difficulty_reason: The author constructs split ascensions over Z[x], uses primitive Hermite-basis modifications to extend invariant factors, and handles the x-minus-one block through a separate integral basis construction. These explicit non-PID module mechanisms close the r=1 induction and yield polynomial Smith forms, beyond rational spectral diagonalization.
